changelog: Fixes the WiFi tab's Forget button being hidden whenever the current connection was set up outside this app's own Connect flow (e.g. a network configured directly via nmcli) - visibility now correctly follows the actual connection state, not just this app's own bookkeeping, which could be empty even while a real network is genuinely active. The confirmation prompt and Remembered-network line also fall back sensibly to the actual current SSID instead of showing an empty value.
